title: Compare Rotation Map across two dates
description: Compare dated Rotation Map readings by stable group key, retaining coverage, roster fallback, exclusions and nulls. Requires start_date before end_date.

start_date.description: Earlier YYYY-MM-DD analytical date; must precede end_date.

end_date.description: Later YYYY-MM-DD analytical date; must follow start_date.

group_by.description: Use the same grouping at both dates.
